_comment: PINNED 2026-08-11: the 'boot-varying world-Y' was never a Y jitter - every harness boot started a NEW GAME with a fresh random seed (measured: seeds 97236116 vs 2066143097, interior Y 1.6 yd apart), so the gate was comparing different worlds. golden-capture now boots forceNew with pinSeed 0.4242. qa-boot gates only the exact onNewGame seed draw and restores native Math.random inside that call, before scene construction; manifest records seed+interiorY - 1035912314 / -0.45135 every run. Measured two-run noise after the pin: 0.0000-0.0622 percent across all 12 poses (shop-floor and stockroom-wall at literal zero). Budgets are 0.25 = roughly 4x the worst measured noise, tight enough that the E1-yaw class (>1 percent family shift) can never hide again. Ignore rects stay: the window view shows LIVE course golfers (runtime randomness is restored after boot, deliberately) and the loose stockroom boxes can topple. 2026-08-11 second calibration: TOOL poses carry idle sway on wall-clock phase (boot-duration shifts it), measured up to 0.51 on tool-mop between two clean runs - tool budgets are 0.75 (still an order under the E1-yaw family class at >1 percent), static poses stay 0.25. bag-packed (the C1 pose: staged 3-item sale, pinned spawn, no despawn) measured 0.105 two-run - budget 0.35. 2026-08-17 tool-mop settled: it read 0.91 against a 0.75 budget on three runs and was NOT noise -- two fresh runs agreed with each other to 0.043 while both sat 0.9 from the golden. The golden was accepted at 44ee725 on 2026-08-14 and six commits after it (47c5326, c8a686b, 9aa97e6, e206faf, 83e5b2b, 62785a4) deliberately rebuilt the mop head: splay 1.30 -> 0.42, the yarn clamped into the hub, the head white. Reverting mopVerlet.js alone to 44ee725 moved the number 0.906 -> 0.784, which puts the rework in the causal path; the remainder is toolViewmodel.js (67 lines changed over the same span). So the reference was stale, not the build. Rebaselined tool-mop ONLY, from a clean run, cross-checked against a second independent run at 0.0231 -- use golden-diff --only <pose> --accept rather than a blanket accept.
